lines.english: Houjou University's festival takes place on the same day as Houjou High School's festival, right next to our… I'll omit the rest; it's getting pretty repetitive.
Today marks the second day of the highly popular Houjou University festival and the somewhat popular Houjou High festival. With it being a Saturday, it's a day off for many people.
And it's also the day of our actual make-or-break performance.
"Yup, we're all set!"
"N-No, wait…"
"Wow… Touma-san, you look amazing!"
"I'm coming in, then."
"I said wait!"
"Ah…"
"W-What do you think?"
"Come on, why aren't you complimenting the both of them with words like 'beautiful', or 'wonderful', or 'freakin' awesome!'?"
"No, I think you should hold back on that last one…"
Paying no heed to their banter, I find myself frozen like a cliche manga protagonist who accidentally entered a room while girls were changing inside.
After all… I'm so captivated by the sight of these two right now that all of Takeya's flattering compliments seem like ridiculous understatements.
"What's the meaning of this, you damn perverted president…? When did I ever agree to wear a costume like this?"
"We decided on the costumes on the day of the rehearsal. So unfortunately, since you didn't come, you forfeited your vote."
"There were a few other candidates I had in mind, but I think this black one suits Touma-san the best."
"So this was your decision, Ogiso!? This color… this design… and just look at how revealing it is!"
"I don't think Setsuna had any bad intentions… Besides, that costume is a perfect contrast to hers."
Black and white… Cool and cute…
If you ask me, these costumes are perfect choices. Considering their respective images, they aren't anything out of the ordinary and totally feel just right.
"All the costumes that Iizuka-kun brought were pretty similar to begin with.
…What should we do? Wanna swap costumes with me?"
"That one would be even worse… I think I'll just wear my school uniform."
"Hey, whoa, don't take your clothes off in front of the guys!"
"I mean, Kitahara's going out in his uniform, isn't he? It's not fair!"
"But, y'know… it'd just be a waste of money to get him a costume. It's only natural to invest in the ones who can draw people's attention, right?"
"I won't be drawing any attention either!"
"You sure will. Starting today."
"You definitely will."
"I imagine you'll draw in a lot of the underclassmen who know nothing about you."
"You guys…"
"It'll only last for about ten minutes anyway. Let's just bite the bullet and get embarrassed together, okay?"
"You may feel embarrassed, but I'm sure those watching you will love it!"
"Ah, by the way, the executive committee will be recording those ten minutes to be preserved for all eternity on the school's website."
"Ki-Kitahara… how long are you planning on keeping that mouth of yours shut? Say something already!"
"No, I… I'm honestly not sure whether I should say what's on my mind or not…"
"Well, how about that. You actually do want to hear Haruki-kun's impression, don't you, Touma-san?"
"No, the things you and I want are quite different, Ogiso."
"I feel like… I won't be able to stop showering the both of you with extremely passionate praise if I start… Could you two bear with me?"
"Wha…"
"Do we look good? Say, these costumes look good on us, don't they?"
"Oh, this is dangerous… Awesome… So awesome… You two look so freakin' awesome! Those costumes look so good on you I can hardly resist!"
"You're the dangerous one here…"
"Ugh, stop, cut it out!"
"Ahahahaha… Hold on, Haruki-kun, you sound like a totally different person right now!"
"Ah, I'm so sorry. But… this really is just too incredible."
"Well, due to obvious reasons, Haruki will toootally ruin the visual impact while you guys are on stage…"
"Still, Takeya, you'd ruin it all the same if you put yourself between these two. It's a pretty big problem either way…"
"Um, well, I mean… Setsuna and… Touma, you're both… how should I say this… perfect?"
"…I said stop it, already."
"But you're glad to hear that, aren't you? Just be honest like me, Touma-san."
"This is why I keep saying I just can't deal with you, Ogiso…"
It's 1 PM right now.
Our debut is only two hours away.

I am incredibly nervous, but even more than that… I feel so excited about finally being able to move my fingers and body more skillfully than I ever have. I feel like I won't make a single mistake while playing today.
Then again, it'll be exactly the sort of situation in which I'm most likely to make a fatal mistake…
No, it's no use worrying about it now.
"Yo, Haruki. Listen, I wanted to talk to you a bit about the Miss Houjou High contest…"
"I am no longer a member of the official nor the unofficial school festival executive committee, you know."
"Well, what you're doing now is like when a former member of an election administration commission becomes the private secretary for the candidate."
"Don't use such a distasteful analogy."
Both executive committees had a lot to say behind my backーnot for quitting in itselfーbut for the reason why I quit.
"The contest is drawing a lot more attention this year. I had a thousand ballot slips printed out, but it's been only two days and we've already run out!"
"The school administration won't let it slide if you keep that up. Be careful not to let the contest's scale get too big."
The reason being is Miss Houjou High differs from Miss Houjou University in that it's unofficial. The school administration doesn't approve of it, but it at least still tolerates the event.
If even the slightest issue occurs, the contest can be canceled on very short notice. That's why the unofficial executive committee has to manage it with the utmost care.
…At least, that's what the committee's previous chairman has informed me of so very eloquently.
"What are you saying, man? Whose fault do you think it is that the contest's scale grew so big this year in the first place…?"
"I'll have you know that everything was handled with a lot more caution while I was still on the committee."
"Well, you quitting the committee and the reason why you did it is what made this year's contest such a big deal."
"You mean Se… Ogiso caused this?"
"Just call her Setsuna. Takeya's already told me everything."
"Told you what!?"
"Plus, the two-time winner of Miss Houjou High is finally going on stage this year, you know? Both of those things have really been making waves."
"…I figured as much, yeah."
"Have you noticed that there are a lot more university students visiting our festival this year? Even though they have their own festival… It's weird, isn't it?"
"Yeah… You're right."
I thought it was just my imagination, but there really are a lot more people who look like university students than usual, even since morning…
They usually come to our festival in the evening, and even then, they only take a short look.
"The high school and the university are on the same server, so I guess they can see our festival's web page."
And vice versa, we can see their web page too. From there, we often gather information to loaf around at their university festival, neglecting our own.
I mean, they have celebrities and scholars coming to their festival as guests. Not to mention almost every event that they hold is on a much larger scale than ours.
Speaking of which, I think I heard something about Ogata Eiji coming to some panel discussion or another as a guest this year…
"Well, I found something interesting on the university's forum. A thread regarding Ogiso's stage appearance… The discussion was pretty lively."
"University students must have a lot of free time…"
"She's gonna be a freshman there next year, so it's no surprise that she's getting all the attention."
"This reflects on the contest too. People are no longer wondering if Ogiso can win the third time in a row, but instead by how much of a lead she will win."
Meaning that she's not only our school's idol anymore, but Houjou University's as well…
At times, I find it hard to link her image as a school idol to who she really isーa girl who feels happy just because I call her "Setsuna."
"Feeling nervous?"
"I can't afford to embarrass myself, no matter what. For both my sake and Setsuna's."
"Are you deliberately pushing the topic in that direction?"
"There's still more than an hour until it starts. What do you wanna do?"
"The other performances have started already, right? How about going to the gymnasium?"
"I don't really care for high schoolers' performances, though."
"But we came here to watch a high school girl sing, y'know?"
That again…
"Hey, Kitahara! Sorry, could you come take a look at something? The battery in our stand is acting weird."
"I don't care. I'm not on the committee."
That's the third group of university students who are here to see our… no, who are here to see Setsuna.
Chikashi wasn't exaggerating. There are definitely a lot more university students around than usual.
Shouldn't it be more meaningful to go to the university festival over the affiliate high school's…?
"Come on, hurry up or there won't be any seats left!"
"Why should I be in the audience…!? This isn't how it should have turned out!"
"You're still going on about that… You brought it upon yourself, you know?"
"Besides, I know that you tried to get on stage just to get more attention, but are you even any good at singing?"
"No way she can sing well either…! I'm sure I'll enjoy laughing at her from the audience!"
"You're so narrow-minded…"
"It's so unfair! It was my plan originally! Then that damn Ogiso Setsuna showed up and ripped me off!"
"Maybe she's even more eager to attract attention than you are, Tomo. That might explain why she's won the contest twice in a row, too."
"Come on, hurry up already!"
Th…That was…
Yeah, I'm pretty sure I just saw someone familiar, but my mind was in denial over it.
"Kitahara-senpai! Sorry, we really need your help! Our cook cut her finger!"
"I keep telling you all, I'm not on the committee! The executive committee members are on standby in that tent over there, so go and ask them for help."
Never mind the university students, a lot of our schoolmates are coming to see her as well.
It's not just guys, either; a lot of girls are also gathering at the gymnasium, just in time to see our performance.
…I have no idea what's going to happen.
"Mom, come on, hurry up!"
"Wow, it's so crowded. This is nothing like a usual high school festival."
"It's so cool… I think I wanna go to this school now, too."
"What are you saying? Takahiro, you wouldn't make it here with your grades, you know."
"But, you know… if I went to a private school just like Nee-chan did, it would be hard to pay my tuition, that's why…"
"If you could enroll here, I'd let you, even if it meant it would be hard on us. Just remember that there are plenty of good public schools too…"
"Aa-ah, there it is, over there! That building must be the gymnasium! Nee-chan's performance is starting at 3 o'clock, right?"
…There goes my opportunity to greet them. I didn't think they'd really come.
University students, our schoolmates, and even family members…
The amount of attention Setsuna is attracting shows no sign of slowing down.
"Hey, do you have a minute?"
"Like I said, I'm not on the commit…!?"
"Could you tell me where the gymnasium is? This is my first time here."
"R-Right this way! Please, I'll take you there."
That was close… I almost lashed out at a guest…
"Only two groups left before us, huh…"
"…Hey, doesn't it seem like the audience has been getting bigger and bigger?"
"Yeah, it looks like there are no seats left. A lot of people are standing. And we're just a light music club that reformed a month ago… This is no joke…"
"Are all these people here to see Setsuna?"
"Well, at the very least, I'm sure nobody came to watch Haruki play the guitar… Looks like there are a few who are here to watch Touma, though."
"Oh, the music students?"
"Then again, they seem to hate her so much. Maybe they're just here hoping to make fun of her?"
"How negative…"
"The more they stand out, the more enemies they'll have… The same goes for Setsuna-chan. If she messes up, they'll turn vicious in a heartbeat."
"What, are you speaking from experience?
Well, I suppose Haruki is the only one standing by you among all the male students, after all."
"You're one to talk, Miss Spartan Captain… Come on, we should go and meet up with them already."
"I hope Setsuna doesn't choke up again… Don't say anything stupid that could put pressure on her, okay?"
"Yo! We're up next, huh? There's a bunch of people standing in the audience just here to see you guys, you know?"
"What did I just tell you a moment ago, dumbass!? Read the mood for once, come on…"
"Let me see… Wow, it's true! Haruki-kun, Haruki-kun, there are so many people!"
As Setsuna walks up the stage discreetly, she peeks at the audience through the gap between the curtains, and describes what she sees.
"Just like I said earlier, see? Word has spread even throughout the university."
In saying that, I only came back here a few minutes ago, so I'm fully aware of the disaster that's waiting for us in the audience, in a way.
"…Also, your mother and brother are here. You should be able to find them if you look through the audience."
Just as I'd expected, most of our audience are "amateurs." They don't usually go to concerts or have much of an interest in music, they're just here to see Setsuna.
"…Having those two watching is just the worst. I'm sure they're gonna chew me out about my singing when I get home. Even though they're completely out of tune themselves when they sing karaoke."
"Wow, you go to karaoke with your family too?"
"…Yeah, but usually they sing one song per person while I end up singing five in a row, so lately they don't really want to go with me."
"You obviously brought that upon yourself. Why can't you seem to have any modesty when it comes to singing?"
"I can't help myself! I can sing better than them anyway, so there shouldn't be any problem if I sing more, right?"
"…What?"
"See? Who can't read the mood now?"
"You two must be so excited due to lack of sleep. After all, we haven't gotten a wink of sleep since yesterday."
"You didn't get any sleep either, Touma. How come you're so calm?"
That said, it's not like I've ever seen her excited even once in the whole half a year I've known her.
"I've been playing the piano at competitions since I was five years old, at least three times a year. And there were… about two times I didn't place first, maybe?"
"…No, I wasn't asking you to boast."
It is something she deserves to boast about, though. I guess she really is a genius.
"Then, I'd like to ask the veteran Touma-san to give us some advice!"
"Setsuna…"
Returning from the side of the stage with the same cheer she had a moment ago, Setsuna approaches Touma with a request.
Whether she's euphoric or restless, there's no sign of that pale, shivering, and frail girl from yesterday.
Even if she makes a careless slip-up now, I'm sure she won't get nervous over it. I can see her strong determination shining through her eyes.
"All right, just one thing, then…"
And even under the dazzling spotlight of the stage, Touma's detached yet fearless expression shows no sign of breaking for even a second.
They're both such reliable partners… If someone's gonna screw up here, it's gonna be me for sure.

"There's no way this will end well with our lack of practice. The responsibility is all on the president, who broke up the club right before the festival, and Kitahara who insisted on reforming the club on such short notice."
"Uwaaah…"
"Sheesh…"
"What a sound argument…"
She didn't say 'if we fail,' but rather asserted that I've failed already…
"These two underestimate music. Besides, Kitahara even proposed that we should add one more song a single day before our actual performance. I seriously doubt his sanity at this point."
"I can see why, yeah."
"That sounds awful."
"W-Wait a minute…"
Even though she composed the song…? Even though she programmed the backing track on her own as well…?
…What is she doing? Shouldn't she be trying to encourage us right now? There's not even ten minutes left before it's our turn, right?
"Then… I guess I'm insane too? Despite all that's happened, I believe that Haruki-kun did the right thing."
"Eh?"
"…There you have it. I guess we've all gone insane by now. So we might just make it, right?"
"Huh…?"
"Let's enjoy ourselves, alright? And let's amaze everyone with our performance, okay?"
"If either of you two run into trouble, just listen to my melody. I'll lead you, alright?"
"For the last song, let's just enjoy ourselves, without worrying about the audience. Because it's our song and our song alone."
"That works for me… How about you, Kitahara?"
"Setsuna… Touma…"
The previous band has finally finished its performance.
In less than ten minutes, we will climb up on this stage and perform in front of this huge audience.
There's no way out anymore. There's no time for us to do one last rehearsal either.
"Let's go, then. Touma-san, Haruki-kun…
I'm sorry for pulling in such a huge audience, okay?"
"Whenever you act all arrogant like that, it just leaves me speechless… Come on, let's go, Kitahara!"
"Yeah! Don't make fun of me if I mess up the solo, you two!"
"I'll definitely make fun of you!"
"I'll point and laugh, no worries."
"You guys…"
Even so, we've done all we can.

In the limited time we had, we've practiced, pulled all-nighters, made an original song, fought amongst each other and reconciled. One of them caught a cold and I took care of her, while the other got stage fright and overcame her fear. And at last, we find ourselves here today.
I don't know if it would be right to call it friendship or something entirely different, but the three of us definitely have a strong bond now… Or so I believe.
So let's make those two weeks of preparation pay off in the next ten minutes!
"What's wrong with those two… trusting Haruki so much. Have they lost their minds?"
"It's a relationship you couldn't get even if you spent your whole life trying to. You can't look at girls in any way but a romantic one, after all."
"…Shut up."
"But… if the three of them are this close right now… it's only going to get worse for them from now on."
As the curtain rolls up…
We're welcomed by a storm of applause far too excessive for our unproven, impromptu band.
And through the gap of the rising curtain, we are met with numerous curious gazes from the audience.
At the center of the stage…
…Stands the highlight of our groupーour singer, who I'm sure is drawing the attention of more than 99% of those present here right now.
As Setsuna begins to sing, a wave of cheering arises, conveying the audience's astonishment to us.
…They had no idea that Setsuna is the solo-karaoke queen. They've never heard her sing, after all.
Most of them probably thought we chose her because of her popularity, and she half-heartedly accepted because she wanted even more attention.
And I'm sure that less than ten people know how many times she's sung this song and how much effort she's put in to polish it in these two weeks.
She's no match for a pro, and there are a lot of amateur singers who can sing better than her.
But her singing far exceeds what an ordinary high school girl can do. I bet that's why they're so astonished right nowーbecause that's all they thought she was.
As for me, on the audience's right side, I concentrate on playing my part while letting Setsuna handle the audience's extraordinary reaction.
There's no need to worry about her now. She's gleaming with confidence, completely different from how scared she was at the rehearsal.
I don't need to think about how to play… Just let my fingers move spontaneously, step by step…
Amazing… My fingers are moving perfectly in spite of myself.
Compared to how terrible I was two weeks ago, this is amazing.
And on stage right, the audience's left side, Touma is playing the keyboard completely unfazed.
Unlike a piano, an electronic synthesizer doesn't require delicate adjustment of force to play. That's why she can keep watching over us the entire time.
"If either of you two run into trouble, just listen to my melody. I'll lead you, all right?"
I'm sure she has every intention of keeping true to those words, and I think it wouldn't be particularly difficult for her to do so either.
Now that the initial excitement has died down, the audience seems to be ready to listen to our performance.
I expected as much, too.
This is originally a quiet song, so I knew we couldn't keep the audience excited from the beginning until the end of the song.
And the fact they're quiet means that they're earnestly listening to Setsuna's singing as well.
From here on, it's only a matter of time before they won't just be focusing on the singing, but will also pay attention to Touma and I performing.
Touma's performance is as perfect as it's ever been.
Even though she's not looked at her fingers even once, she's completely on-key and her tempo is flawless.
She's also stopped worrying about Setsuna, so she's free to focus on my finger movements.
…I really am the most unreliable member of this band of ours, huh?
Still, even with how unreliable I am… I think I'm doing pretty well so far.
It's like something inside of me has awoken; my finger movement and coordination are top-notch. I basically haven't made any mistakes so far.
In any case, my mind's drifting off to focus on the solo in our second song, but my intuition is still handling this perfectly in spite of myself.
That said… This is me I'm talking about. And it wouldn't be me if I didn't have some sort of contingency in mind.
…That very concern has found its way even into my next plan.
"Touma, it's almost time."
"Are we really doing this?"
I give a suggestive wink to Touma, who's been looking at my fingers all along.
It's a plan that I came up with on a whim, and one which Touma frowned upon as a ridiculous street performance.
"I'm telling you, they're gonna love it!"
"…Don't blame me if something goes wrong."
Even after another few encouraging winks from me, Touma looks at me with doubt and a bit of ridicule, but her gaze remains as cool as ever.
"Do it, Touma!"
"I'll do it if that's what it takes to shut you up."
In the end, she candidly sticks out her tongue at me…
She leaves her keyboard and makes her way to the center of the stage.
Touma…
Despite playing the saxophone, which is not her specialty, she's still composed enough to wink back at me.
"See, I told you! They loved it!"
"I guess, yeah."
"…This is ridiculous."
"I can't believe Touma of all people is pulling such a stunt…"
"This is an affront to music. After being called a genius and prodigy, and being pampered to no end, she lowers herself to this? Disappointing."
"…Were you expecting something from her? I thought you hated her the most."
"I can't bear to look at this charade anymore. That's not my rival anymore, that's just a clown showing off a stupid skit."
"I don't think Touma ever thought of you as a rival, though. I don't recall you ever beating her in any competition."
"Oh, shut the hell up already!"
"But, you know, this time… it's their win again, isn't it?"
"What is!?"
"Just look…"
"How do you feel about all of this?"
